issue_title: Homepage performance persistently below 85 — LCP stuck above 6 s for 5+ consecutive audits; project pages also regressed
issue_body:
# Performance Regression — Persistent LCP > 6 s on Homepage + New Regressions on Project Pages

**Audited:** 2026-07-31T10:51:57.564Z
**Status:** Warnings (5th+ consecutive audit below threshold on homepage)

## Problem 1: Homepage (/) — Persistent LCP
The homepage has failed to reach a Lighthouse performance score of 85 for at least five consecutive nightly audits. The LCP has been above 6 s each time, indicating no structural fix has been applied.

| Audit date | Perf | LCP |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-07-27 (est.) | ~69 | ~6.46 s |
| 2026-07-28 (est.) | ~69 | ~6.46 s |
| 2026-07-29 | 70 | 6.57 s |
| 2026-07-30 | 73 | 6.70 s |
| **2026-07-31** | **74** | **6.26 s** |

## Problem 2: Project Pages — New Performance Regressions
Three project pages dropped materially (>5 pts) compared to the previous audit:

| Page | Prev Perf | Curr Perf | Delta | Prev LCP | Curr LCP |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| /projects | 92 | 83 | -9 | 2.91 s | 3.66 s |
| /projects/note-structurer | 92 | 74 | -18 | 2.84 s | 4.49 s |
| /projects/screenshot-to-primevue | 92 | 80 | -12 | 2.98 s | 4.06 s |

These regressions may be measurement variance on a single Lighthouse run, but the consistent direction across all three pages (and the large magnitude on note-structurer) warrants investigation.

## Problem 3: /about — Placeholder Content + SEO Below Threshold
`/about` remains a blank placeholder ("This is an about page") with no nav, content, or footer. SEO score is 83 (below 85 threshold). This page is actively linked from the main nav.

## Recommended fixes
1. **Hero image:** Add `<link rel="preload" as="image" href="[hero-image]">` in `<head>`, convert to WebP/AVIF, serve at mobile-appropriate srcset breakpoints.
2. **Render-blocking resources:** Defer or async any JS/CSS not needed for initial paint on `/` and project pages.
3. **Project pages:** Investigate whether a new dependency or JS bundle was added that is increasing LCP/TBT across all project detail pages.
4. **About page:** Replace stub content with real about page content including nav and footer.

**Expected outcome:** 15–20+ point performance improvement on homepage; project pages should recover to 85+ if the regression is addressed.
